_slice: BC municipal companions — Kamloops, Smithers, Prince George
_note: Intentional municipal companion set for geographic and size contrast: Kamloops (largest Interior city), Prince George (northern regional centre), Smithers (smaller northern resource town). All three follow the same Community Charter cycle (five-year financial plan bylaw under s.165 before the tax bylaw; annual report + audited statements under s.167). All rest on the BC Assessment roll for property-value taxation. Smithers is new; Kamloops and Prince George nodes are retained/refined for consistency of description and evidence.

proposed_reports.title: City of Kamloops Five-Year Financial Plan
proposed_reports.description: Five-year financial plan adopted by bylaw under Community Charter s.165 (most recent 2026–2030, Bylaw No. 16-331). Sets general operating, water, sewer and capital budgets and the property-tax revenue requirement for the largest city in the Thompson-Okanagan / Interior. Property-tax rates are applied to values determined by BC Assessment.

proposed_reports.title: City of Kamloops Annual Report and Consolidated Financial Statements
proposed_reports.description: Annual report required by Community Charter s.167, including audited consolidated financial statements prepared under Public Sector Accounting Standards, operating and financial highlights, and statistical information.

proposed_reports.title: City of Prince George Five-Year Operating and Capital Financial Plans
proposed_reports.description: Five-year operating and capital financial plans adopted by bylaw under Community Charter s.165 (e.g. Bylaw No. 9538, 2025 for 2025–2029). Sets the tax levy, utility rates and capital program for the largest city in northern British Columbia. Property-value taxes rest on the BC Assessment roll.

proposed_reports.title: City of Prince George Annual Report (including Audited Financial Statements and Statement of Financial Information)
proposed_reports.description: Annual municipal report required by the Community Charter, containing audited consolidated financial statements, Statement of Financial Information under the Financial Information Act, tax exemptions, and performance measures. Presented to Council by 30 June each year.

proposed_reports.title: Town of Smithers Five-Year Financial Plan
proposed_reports.description: Five-year financial plan adopted by bylaw under Community Charter s.165 (e.g. 2025–2029 Bylaw No. 1991/1992). Sets general municipal, utility and airport fund budgets and the property-tax revenue requirement for this smaller northern resource community. Explicitly distinguishes non-market change from market-driven assessment growth when calculating the tax levy.

proposed_reports.title: Town of Smithers Annual Report and Consolidated Financial Statements
proposed_reports.description: Annual report and audited consolidated financial statements prepared under Canadian public sector accounting standards and Community Charter s.167 / Financial Information Act. Includes Statement of Financial Information (SOFI) and is presented to Council for public consideration.

dependencies.basis: The financial plan establishes the property-tax revenue requirement; tax rates are then set on the assessed values of land and improvements determined by BC Assessment, as required for all BC municipalities.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The assessed values for every taxable property in B.C. is annually determined by BC Assessment. Tax rates are expressed as a dollar figure per $1,000 dollars of assessed property value of land and improvements.

dependencies.basis: Same statutory mechanism: the five-year financial plan sets the tax levy; rates are applied to BC Assessment values. Prince George’s plan documents explicitly reference non-market change when calculating the general tax levy increase.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The assessed values for every taxable property in B.C. is annually determined by BC Assessment.

dependencies.basis: The Town’s financial-plan schedules separate ‘Property Taxes – Non Market Change’ from the general levy and state that property value is determined by BC Assessment and is a key factor in the tax calculation.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Please note that your property value is determined by BC Assessment and is a key factor in a tax calculation. If your property value increased more than the 14% average for Smithers, the Town increase will be higher.

dependencies.basis: Audited results and statistical information are presented against the financial plan adopted for the same fiscal year under the Community Charter.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The City of Kamloops Annual Report includes general corporate information from the year, operating and financial highlights framed around Council's Strategic Plan, and detailed financial statements.

dependencies.basis: The Annual Report contains the audited financial statements and performance measures for the year whose financial plan was adopted under Community Charter s.165.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The Annual Municipal Report offers residents an opportunity to learn more about the City’s operations and performance. The report includes audited financial statements, tax exemptions, services and operations for the previous year, the City’s priorities, and measures of its activities and objectives. Prepared in accordance with the Community Charter.

dependencies.basis: Consolidated financial statements and the Annual Report are prepared with budget figures taken from the Five-Year Financial Plan bylaw for the corresponding year.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Budget figures are from the Town of Smithers Bylaw No. 1956 - Five-Year Financial Plan (2023-2027) adopted by Council on May 9, 2023.

dependencies.basis: The bylaw itself cites Community Charter s.165 as the statutory requirement to prepare a five-year financial plan before the annual property-tax bylaw.
dependencies.evidence_quote: WHEREAS, Section 165 of the Community Charter requires the Council of the Town of Smithers to prepare, by Bylaw, a Five-Year Financial Plan before the Annual Property Tax Bylaw is adopted.
